name: Books Tab Per-Class Composition Artifacts
description: Pre-compute per-class (top-9 + Other per asset class) composition artifacts for the Books tab ConsolidatedOverviewPanel at N1 (firm) and L2 (advisor) drill levels. Script 12 on EC2 reads holdings_lots + rel_architect_lookup, produces firm_composition.json and per-advisor composition.json. Two new Lambda routes (no-store cache) serve them. Frontend adapter makes ConsolidatedOverviewPanel schema-polymorphic across N1/L2 (new) and L3/L4 (existing).
phase: Phase 1: All 4 task orders issued (2026-03-19). DS gates: WS1 (script 12 + run_gold_layer.sh) + WS2 (Lambda v2.8 commit). RD parallel track. DT gates on DS WS2 commit. AE gates on DS WS1 commit.
blocking: DS ADVI_BKSCMP.001 (script 12 + Lambda v2.8 commits). RD ADVI_BKSCMP.002 is parallel.
